ru_01.m_zh: 讲故事的开头，轻柔缓慢；“都去世了”前面真的停一下；温柔，但不要阴沉
ru_01.d_zh: 画面：清晨天刚亮，你望着一条长长的土路，路上只有两个小小的身影。你轻轻地讲，像怕吵醒睡着的孩子。
ru_01.m_en: soft, slow storyteller opening; a real pause before 'died'; tender, never gloomy
ru_01.d_en: Picture: early morning, just getting light. You look at a long dusty road with two small people on it. You speak softly, as if a child is asleep nearby.

ru_02.m_zh: 疲惫、慈爱、有点哽咽；开口前先叹口气；最后的“啊”很轻，几乎在求她
ru_02.d_zh: 画面：你背着小包袱站在岔路口，握着路得的手，轻轻把她往回推。你舍不得她，可你想让她过好日子。
ru_02.m_en: tired, loving, a little choked; a sigh first; the last 'all right' is soft, almost begging
ru_02.d_en: Picture: you stand where the road splits, with a small bag on your back. You hold Ruth's hand and gently push her back. You will miss her, but you want her to have a good life.

ru_03.m_zh: 发自内心，快哭了但很稳；“不，我不走”又快又坚定，后面放慢变暖；“你的上帝”前吸一口气；全剧最重要的一句
ru_03.d_zh: 画面：婆婆正把你往回推，你一把抱住她的胳膊不放。你看着她的眼睛，一句一句地许下一生的承诺。
ru_03.m_en: heartfelt, near tears but steady; quick and firm on 'No, I won't leave you', then slower and warmer; a breath before 'Your God'; the most important line
ru_03.d_en: Picture: Naomi is pushing you away, so you hold her arm and do not let go. You look into her eyes and make a promise for your whole life, one sentence at a time.

ru_04.m_zh: 声音里有走路的节奏；“终于”亮起来；说到收大麦时微微一笑
ru_04.d_zh: 画面：你跟着她们一步一步翻过山坡，脚都走酸了。忽然山那边露出一片金黄的麦田，你松了一口气。
ru_04.m_en: a walking rhythm in the voice; brighter on 'at last'; a small smile on the harvest
ru_04.d_en: Picture: you walk with them over hill after hill and your feet are tired. Then you see a golden field on the other side, and you feel glad.

ru_05.m_zh: 先长长叹一口气；安静、空落落的；慢，后半句之前断一下
ru_05.d_zh: 画面：你推开老房子的木门，屋里空空的，满是灰尘。你摸着门框，想起从前一家人在这里吃饭的样子。
ru_05.m_en: a long sigh first; quiet, empty; slow, with a break before the second half
ru_05.d_en: Picture: you push open the old wooden door. The house is empty and dusty. You touch the door frame and remember your family eating here long ago.

ru_06.m_zh: 先温柔，然后明亮有干劲，带点笑；结尾快一点
ru_06.d_zh: 画面：你蹲下来搂住婆婆的肩膀，然后指着窗外金灿灿的麦田。你已经卷起袖子，准备出门了。
ru_06.m_en: gentle first, then bright and eager with a little smile; quicker at the end
ru_06.d_en: Picture: you bend down and put your arm around Naomi. Then you point out of the window at the golden field. Your sleeves are already rolled up.

ru_07.m_zh: 平静地解释，像爸爸妈妈指着图画讲；“一根一根”说慢
ru_07.d_zh: 画面：你和孩子一起趴在图画书上，你用手指点着田边跪着的路得。说到“一根一根”时，你也学着捡的动作。
ru_07.m_en: calm and explaining, like a parent pointing at a picture; slow on 'one stalk at a time'
ru_07.d_en: Picture: you and a child lean over the picture book. Your finger points at Ruth on her knees by the field. On 'one stalk at a time', you pretend to pick them up too.

ru_08.d_zh: 画面：你看见一个高高的人从田那头大步走来，工人们都笑着朝他挥手。你悄悄告诉孩子：这是个好人。
ru_08.d_en: Picture: a tall man walks across the field with big steps, and the workers smile and wave at him. You tell the child quietly: this is a good man.

ru_09.m_zh: 爽朗友好，声音要能传过整块田；大大的笑容
ru_09.d_zh: 画面：早晨你走到自己的麦田边，工人们散在很远的地方弯腰割麦。你举起手，朝他们大声打招呼。
ru_09.m_en: hearty and friendly, loud enough to cross a field; a big smile
ru_09.d_en: Picture: it is morning and you come to your own field. Your workers are far away, cutting barley. You lift your hand and call out to greet them.

ru_10.m_zh: 三四个工人隔着田一起回答，开心，不用太整齐
ru_10.d_zh: 画面：你正弯腰割麦子，听见老板的声音，直起腰擦擦汗。你和旁边的伙伴一起朝他喊回去。
ru_10.m_en: three or four workers answering together across the field, cheerful, not in perfect unison
ru_10.d_en: Picture: you are bent over, cutting barley. You hear the boss, stand up and wipe your face. You and your friends shout back to him.

ru_11.m_zh: 走到一半停住，好奇又温和；先“咦”地想一下
ru_11.d_zh: 画面：你走着走着，忽然看见田边有个没见过的姑娘在捡麦穗。你停下脚步，小声问身边的工人。
ru_11.m_en: stops mid-step, curious and gentle; a thinking 'hm' first
ru_11.d_en: Picture: you are walking, and then you see a young woman you do not know, picking up grain at the edge of the field. You stop and ask the worker beside you.

ru_12.m_zh: 和气，像爸爸一样，不着急；说到“那边”时指向水罐
ru_12.d_zh: 画面：你走到路得面前，她低着头有点紧张。你弯下一点腰，让她放心，然后抬手指给她看树荫下的水罐。
ru_12.m_en: kind, fatherly, unhurried; point toward the jars on 'water jars'
ru_12.d_en: Picture: you walk up to Ruth. She looks down and is a little nervous. You bend a little to make her feel safe, then you point to the water jars under the tree.

ru_13.m_zh: 害羞、惊讶，几乎是悄悄话；问句轻轻往上扬
ru_13.d_zh: 画面：你抱着一小把麦穗，深深鞠了一躬。你不敢相信，这里居然有人对一个外地人这么好。
ru_13.m_en: shy, amazed, almost a whisper; the question rises gently
ru_13.d_en: Picture: you hold a few stalks of barley and bow low. You cannot believe that someone here is so kind to a stranger.

ru_14.m_zh: 温暖、被感动；声音里带笑；祝福的那句稍慢
ru_14.d_zh: 画面：你看着这个满头是汗的姑娘，想起别人说她怎样照顾婆婆。你把手放在胸口，真心为她祝福。
ru_14.m_en: warm and moved; a smile in the voice; the blessing a little slower
ru_14.d_en: Picture: you look at this hard-working young woman and remember what people said about how she cares for Naomi. You put a hand on your heart and bless her.

ru_15.m_zh: 舞台上的悄悄话，调皮、咧着嘴笑；慢慢的、神神秘秘，“留给她捡”俏皮地上扬
ru_15.d_zh: 画面：你左看看、右看看，把工人们招到身边围成一圈。你压低声音安排一个善意的小把戏，像在准备惊喜。
ru_15.m_en: stage whisper, playful, a grin; slow and secret, then a cheeky lift on 'for her'
ru_15.d_en: Picture: you look left, then right, and wave your workers into a little circle. You whisper a kind little trick, like planning a surprise.

ru_16.m_zh: 越说越高兴；“满满一大捆”说得又大又圆
ru_16.d_zh: 画面：金色的夕阳下，路得抱着一捆比她肩膀还宽的大麦往家走。你张开双臂，比给孩子看有多大。
ru_16.m_en: growing delight; big and round on 'great big bundle'
ru_16.d_en: Picture: in the golden evening sun, Ruth carries home a bundle wider than her shoulders. You open your arms to show the child how big it is.

ru_17.m_zh: 真的很吃惊，她第一次听起来开心；说“这么多呀”时笑出一点声
ru_17.d_zh: 画面：你听见脚步声去开门，一大捆麦子差点撞到你的鼻子。你瞪大眼睛，捧起麦子闻了又闻。
ru_17.m_en: truly amazed, the first time she sounds happy; a little laugh on 'so much'
ru_17.d_en: Picture: you hear steps and open the door. A huge bundle of barley almost hits your nose. Your eyes go wide and you lift the grain to smell it.

ru_18.d_zh: 画面：你把大捆麦子“咚”地放在地上，擦一把汗。你像放学回家的孩子，急着把今天的好事告诉妈妈。
ru_18.d_en: Picture: you drop the big bundle on the floor and wipe your face. You are like a child home from school with good news for Mum.

ru_19.m_zh: 惊讶变成喜乐和感恩的眼泪；“他没有忘记我们”前声音哽一下
ru_19.d_zh: 画面：听到这个名字，你手里的麦穗都掉了。你抬头望着天，眼泪流下来，可嘴角是笑着的。
ru_19.m_en: surprise turning into joy and thankful tears; a catch in the voice before 'He hasn't forgotten us'
ru_19.d_en: Picture: when you hear that name, the grain falls from your hands. You look up at the sky. Tears come, but you are smiling.

ru_20.m_zh: 压低声音，夜里的感觉，有点神秘、带着盼望
ru_20.d_zh: 画面：夜深了，满天星星，远处打谷场上亮着一盏小油灯。你踮着脚跟在路得后面，说话轻得像怕惊动月亮。
ru_20.m_en: hushed, night-time, a little secret and hopeful
ru_20.d_en: Picture: it is late and the sky is full of stars. Far away, one small lamp shines at the threshing floor. You tiptoe behind Ruth and speak very softly.

ru_21.m_zh: 轻柔、紧张、勇敢；“求您”之前小小吸一口气
ru_21.d_zh: 画面：你站在小油灯旁边，面前是高高的麦堆和波阿斯。你心跳得很快，但为了婆婆，你还是开了口。
ru_21.m_en: soft, nervous, brave; small breath before 'will you please'
ru_21.d_en: Picture: you stand by the little oil lamp. In front of you are a tall heap of grain and Boaz. Your heart beats fast, but you speak up for Naomi.

ru_22.m_zh: 非常温柔，说到承诺时坚定有把握；带着笑
ru_22.d_zh: 画面：灯光里，你看见她紧张得攥着手。你先放轻声音安慰她，然后挺直身子，像举手发誓一样答应她。
ru_22.m_en: very gentle, then firm and sure on the promise; a smile
ru_22.d_en: Picture: in the lamp light you see her hands held tight. First you speak softly to calm her. Then you stand tall and promise, like raising your hand.

ru_23.m_zh: 明亮开心，让人听得出你在笑
ru_23.d_zh: 画面：早晨，花棚下花瓣飘下来，全城的人挤在一起拍手。你也站在人群里，踮起脚看新郎新娘。
ru_23.m_en: bright and happy, a smile you can hear
ru_23.d_en: Picture: it is morning. Flower petals fall under the wedding tent and the whole town claps. You stand in the crowd on your toes to see the bride and groom.

ru_24.m_zh: 轻柔，像往摇篮里看；名字说得慢
ru_24.d_zh: 画面：你弯下腰，看着摇篮里睡着的小宝宝，小拳头握得紧紧的。你怕吵醒他，轻轻说出他的名字。
ru_24.m_en: soft and tender, like looking into a cradle; slow on the name
ru_24.d_en: Picture: you bend over a cradle. A baby is asleep with tiny fists closed. You do not want to wake him, so you say his name very gently.

ru_25.m_zh: 高兴得流泪，半哭半笑；有摇宝宝的节奏；最后几个字满是惊叹
ru_25.d_zh: 画面：你把小孙子抱在怀里轻轻地摇，他的小手抓住你的手指。你想起那间空房子，再看看怀里的他。
ru_25.m_en: happy tears, half laughing; a rocking rhythm; the last words full of wonder
ru_25.d_en: Picture: you rock your grandson in your arms and his tiny hand holds your finger. You remember the empty house, and then you look at him.

ru_26.m_zh: 调皮，凑近分享一个秘密；说到“大卫”时来个开心的大揭晓
ru_26.d_zh: 画面：你把孩子拉近，用手拢在他耳边，像要说一个大秘密。说出“大卫”的时候，你等着看他眼睛一亮。
ru_26.m_en: playful, leaning in to share a secret; a big happy reveal on 'David'
ru_26.d_en: Picture: you pull the child close and cup your hand by their ear for a big secret. When you say 'David', you wait for their eyes to light up.

ru_27.m_zh: 温暖的道理，直接对孩子说；最后一句带着笑
ru_27.d_zh: 画面：书合上了，图画里的一家人还在朝你们挥手。你搂住孩子的肩膀，看着他，把最后一句话送给他。
ru_27.m_en: warm moral, speaking right to the child; smile on the last sentence
ru_27.d_en: Picture: the book is closed, and the family in the picture is still waving. You put your arm around the child and say the last words just for them.
